title: Draft a copy of a workflow version

v1.description: What happens when a version is carried forward: a new draft is opened beside it with a copy of its diagram, and of its graph where the diagram does not own one. This is how an active or retired version is changed at all - neither may be edited where it stands, because instances are following it, so what the manager offers instead is a copy that may be. A draft is not offered this, since it can simply be edited; a version whose state cannot be read is, since copying it is the only way left to carry its diagram forward - which is why this start event's guard excludes drafts rather than listing the states it allows.

draft.label: Copy the version into a new draft
